title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre - University of California on 1982-05-22
source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M) -> Dat -> CD

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear Charlie Miller soundboard capture of a tight Greek run, highlighted by a rippin Deal solo and flawless Supplication/China > Rider jams.
ai_review.review: The recording shines with excellent Charlie Miller mix quality, delivering a crisp, full‑frequency soundboard experience. The show itself is praised for its tight bandwork – especially the scorching Deal solo, the tight Lazy River/Supplication transition, and the seamless China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider jam – making this night one of the standout Greek shows of ’82.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating is 4.0; comments uniformly praise both performance and sound quality, with no serious complaints. Weighted toward a strong show (70%) and excellent recording (30%).

recording_quality.technical_notes: Charlie Miller mix is described as fantastic, crisp and clear throughout with no reported drop‑outs or distortion.

standout_songs: Cumberland Blues (first half of second set)
China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: The Greek run is noted for its tightness and seamless transitions; the first half of the second set, especially Cumberland Blues and the jam pairings, are highlighted as well‑executed.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Deal solo called the most rippin ever; Tennessee Jed solo praised for a clever, story‑like guitar narrative.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weird intro to "Man Smart, Woman Smarter" noted, but vocals lock in once Bob starts singing.
